boundary: All variants use the same allocation-free Corgi port at pinned 41e8731. Three interleaved runs per variant; each 11 timings plus separate allocation pass. 50000 keys, eight values/key. Reconciliation only; presentation and verification excluded. System allocator, scalar u64 time.

variants.order_buffers: Reuse input value-ID order and reconcile into correction tail; scalar equality
variants.batch_equality: Order/buffer reuse plus gathered bulk equality (rejected for the combined fix)

decision: Keep order/buffer reuse, remove gathered equality from proposed runtime code. Underlying allocation-free scalar comparison is the prerequisite integration target. Indexed bulk comparison without operand gathers remains an unmeasured future option.
reproduction: Apply ready DDIR reduce diff to master-next; compare to unmodified master-next and to ready diff + reduce-gather-equality-prototype.patch, all with the same local Corgi override. The order_buffers timing binary disabled the helper in place; final proposed source removes dead helper/dispatch/test code.
validation: Full cargo test -p interactive -p ddir-server passed on retained order/buffer source, both with pinned Corgi and with local allocation-free Corgi; five existing ignored tests. All integration benchmark cases verified emitted columns and steady-state corrections.
